string.text: Greetings, traveler. I am {LORD.NAME} of {EQ_LORD_CLAN}. I don't recognize your cutie mark — who might you be?
A new face! I am {LORD.NAME}, and I serve {EQ_LORD_KINGDOM}. And you must be one of those they whisper about in the taverns?
Hold on, no rush. I am {LORD.NAME}. Around here we introduce ourselves — even very busy ponies.
Hello there! I am {LORD.NAME} of {EQ_LORD_CLAN}. Celestia teaches us: every stranger is a friend we haven't had tea with yet.
Who has the wind blown in? I am {LORD.NAME}. Speak — who are you and what brings you here?[if:convo_thinking]
Ah, {PLAYER.NAME}. What brings you to me?
{PLAYER.NAME}! What news from Equus?
You again, {PLAYER.NAME}. I hope it's business — my troops haven't been fed.
Greetings, {PLAYER.NAME}. Speak, but keep it short: the sun won't raise itself. Though we do have a princess for that.
{PLAYER.NAME}. Good to see you. Tea? No? To business, then.
Hello, {PLAYER.NAME}. How may {EQ_LORD_CLAN} be of service?
{PLAYER.NAME}, my friend! How glad I am to see you![if:convo_happy]
Ha! {PLAYER.NAME}! Now this is a meeting! Pinkie would have thrown a party by now.[if:convo_happy]
{PLAYER.NAME}! For you I always have time — and a slice of apple pie.[if:convo_happy]
My good friend {PLAYER.NAME}! Tell me how I can help — {EQ_LORD_CLAN} remembers kindness.[if:convo_happy]
{PLAYER.NAME}. I can't say I'm glad to see you.[if:convo_annoyed]
You again. Make it quick — you give me split ends.[if:convo_annoyed]
{PLAYER.NAME}... Love and tolerance, love and tolerance... What do you want?[if:convo_annoyed]
Hm. If not for the laws of hospitality, this conversation wouldn't be happening.[if:convo_annoyed]
{PLAYER.NAME}! In the name of {EQ_LORD_KINGDOM} — lay down your arms or prepare to fight![if:convo_angry][ib:aggressive]
You chose the wrong side, {PLAYER.NAME}. Now you'll learn what {EQ_LORD_CLAN} is worth![if:convo_angry][ib:aggressive]
Caught you! Surrender, {PLAYER.NAME}, and maybe a warm cell awaits you instead of cold ground.[if:convo_angry][ib:aggressive]
There will be no harmony today, {PLAYER.NAME}. Only steel![if:convo_angry][ib:aggressive]
For {EQ_LORD_KINGDOM}! Take them![if:convo_angry][ib:aggressive]
You again, {PLAYER.NAME}? We just saw each other...
{PLAYER.NAME}? Forget something?
Again? You're just like Pinkie — everywhere at once.
Yes, yes, {PLAYER.NAME}, I'm listening...
